title: Lock approved completion reports + admin unlock endpoint
tech: Node.js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma 6, Zod, Vitest
keyConstraints: TypeScript strict mode, Zod validation server-side, .nullish() not .optional().nullable(), Prisma selects must include all returned fields (jobInclude is source of truth)
description: Approved completion reports must be locked — no edits allowed once approvedAt is set. This protects the customer signature and the agreed job record. An Admin-only unlock endpoint resets approvedAt to null, allowing re-editing when a genuine correction is needed. All lock checks happen server-side; the frontend relies on the 403 response to reflect state.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/jobs/:id/completion-report returns 403 with { error: 'Completion report is locked after approval. Admin must unlock before editing.' } if completionReport.approvedAt is not null
POST /api/jobs/:id/completion-report/approve returns 403 if completionReport.approvedAt is already set (prevent double-approve)

POST /api/jobs/:id/completion-report/unlock is added, Admin role only; sets completionReport.approvedAt to null and returns { data: updatedCompletionReport }; returns 404 if no completion report exists
Unlock action is recorded in audit_logs with event type COMPLETION_REPORT_UNLOCKED (add to AuditEvent enum) including jobId and unlockedBy userId
npx tsc --noEmit passes with no errors
implementationNotes: Do not rewrite working code — only add what is missing.

Lock check in completion-report.service.ts: before upsert, query existing report and check approvedAt; if set, throw a 403-equivalent error that the route handler catches and returns as { error: '...' } with status 403.
Double-approve check: same pattern — query before approve, if approvedAt already set return 403.
Unlock endpoint: PATCH or POST /api/jobs/:id/completion-report/unlock — use POST to avoid confusion with job PATCH. Route must be registered before the generic /:id routes to avoid param conflicts.
AuditEvent enum is in backend/prisma/schema.prisma — add COMPLETION_REPORT_UNLOCKED there, then run npx prisma generate.
jobInclude in job.service.ts is the source of truth for job response shape — completionReport fields are already included; verify approvedAt is in the select.
Prisma: after schema change run npx prisma generate before starting server.
adminOnly middleware is already exported from middleware/requireRole.ts — use it on the unlock route.
createdById / unlockedBy must come from req.user.id (JWT), never from request body.
securityConsiderations: Unlock is Admin-only — enforce with adminOnly middleware, not just a role check in the handler. Audit log the unlock so there is a traceable record of who unlocked and when. Never allow a Driver or Dispatcher to call the unlock endpoint.
